name: Uploadcare

logos.label: Lockup · dark background
logos.note: Glyph #FFCF3E + white wordmark. The preferred first-contact treatment.

logos.label: Lockup · light background
logos.note: On light backgrounds the glyph shifts to #FFBD18 with a black wordmark.

logos.label: Glyph — the donut waffle
logos.note: 8×8 pixel grid, pixel-to-cell ratio 0.85 for general use. Can stand alone once context is set.

logos.label: Wordmark
logos.note: Never used alone — only in a lockup with the glyph. Uses currentColor.

fonts.role: Primary — body text and headings (Inter Variable)

guidelines: The "donut waffle" glyph is an 8×8 pixel grid. Pixel-to-cell ratio varies by use case — 0.85 for general purposes, up to 1.0 for favicons, lower for illustration.
The wordmark is never used alone; only in a lockup with the glyph. Prefer dark backgrounds when possible.
Prefer the full lockup with the yellow glyph on first contact. Once context is set, switch to subtler variants: glyph only, dim gray when appropriate.
The monochrome lockup is for mediums that don't allow color.
Minimal safe space around the lockup: 3 pixel cells on each side.
Color rule is restraint — the base is a digitally neutral grayscale; bright colors are singular accents, like glowing indicators on a dashboard.
The brand color is yellow; avoid its shades except the light-background variant. The action color is blue; avoid shades except UI states.
Don't rearrange the elements of a lockup. Don't place the logo on complex backgrounds. Don't use non-brand colors.

name: Tiugo
tagline: Tiugo is the embedded AI content layer: developer tools that let enterprises create, govern and scale content with confidence. Governance, visibility and control are built in, not added on.

about.label: Mission
about.text: We deliver market-leading content creation and collaboration tools that empower professional software teams to accelerate digital innovation.

about.label: Vision
about.text: Creating a global community of millions of developers and product managers who love and trust our products.

logos.label: Wordmark · Neutrals 900
logos.note: The Tiugo wordmark is our primary signature. Use it wherever there is room for the full name. Neutrals 900 logo on light backgrounds.

logos.label: Logomark
logos.note: Always the T on its Orange 500 tile. The tile is part of the mark, not a background.

logos.label: Logomark · on a dark background
logos.note: Keep the tile exactly as it is. Don’t add outlines, shadows or a lighter version.

logoSpecs.label: Clear space
logoSpecs.note: Keep at least 0.5X clear on every side. X is the height of the lowercase letters.

logoSpecs.label: Min. size · logomark
logoSpecs.note: At icon sizes the logomark replaces the full logo and stays legible down to 16 px.

logoSpecs.label: Min. size · wordmark
logoSpecs.note: Use the wordmark wherever there is room for the full name.

logoSpecs.label: Construction
logoSpecs.note: One module = the T crossbar’s height and every stroke’s width. The notches in the T, u and g use the same module.

logoSpecs.label: Co-branding
logoSpecs.note: Partner logos sit side by side at the same optical height, split by a thin Neutrals 300 line. Keep at least 1X of space on each side of the line and never lock the logos into one shape.

logoContrast.note: Which logo color goes on which background, with the contrast ratio for each pairing. Use the Neutrals 900 logo on light backgrounds and the Neutrals 50 logo on dark ones. Pairings marked with a cross fall below 3:1 and must not be used.

logoDonts: Do not add a drop shadow
Do not use Orange 500 on Neutrals 100

colorGroups.note: Neutrals 900 and Neutrals 100 do the work, Orange 500 marks action and emphasis, and Neutrals 400 softens surfaces and borders.
Eleven warm grey steps with a slight green undertone. Light steps carry backgrounds and surfaces, the middle steps borders and secondary text, the dark steps text and dark sections.
500 for actions and emphasis, 600 for hover and pressed states, 300 and 200 for soft highlights.
Violet, Blue, Fuchsia and Green support Orange in tags, data and illustrations, never as large backgrounds.

colorRoles.note: Light and dark sections of the website use the same roles: background, surface, border, text, secondary text and action. Build from these roles, not from hex values, and a component works in both.

sample.title: We deliver market-leading content creation and collaboration tools that empower professional software teams to accelerate digital innovation.
sample.card: Four product brands: CKEditor, TinyMCE, Uploadcare, ButterCMS

colorUsage.note: Neutral colors form the foundation of every layout. Keep Orange 500 around 5% for key actions and highlights. Use spectrum colors sparingly in gradients, illustrations, and data visualizations.

textPairs.note: Use approved text and background color combinations to maintain readability and visual consistency.

fonts.role: Primary typeface, from headlines to body copy. 500 Medium for headlines, titles and numbers; 400 Light for body copy; 300 Extra Light for large light headlines.
Used only for eyebrows, labels, metadata, numbers and code.
Substitute for Aspekta in Google Docs, Slides or email. Same weights and roles: Medium replaces Aspekta 500, Regular replaces Aspekta 400.

iconSystem.name: Lucide
iconSystem.text: We use Lucide: open-source outline icons on a 24 px grid with a 2 px stroke and round caps. Use them at 24 px in Neutrals 900 or 600, always next to a label. The full set lives on the library Icons page.

mediaPacks.title: Gradients & hero pattern
mediaPacks.note: Use the gradient images from the website: soft, grainy, flowing from deep blue through lilac into orange. Crop them freely, but never put long text on them or build new gradients from palette colors.

mediaPacks.title: Meeting backgrounds
mediaPacks.note: Keep meeting backgrounds clean and on-brand. Use the brand logo and signature patterns to create a consistent, recognizable look.

mediaPacks.title: LinkedIn covers & avatar
mediaPacks.note: Social media banners combine the Tiugo logo, brand patterns, and typography. Use approved layouts for both light and dark backgrounds, keeping text clear and key elements visible.

guidelines.text: The Tiugo wordmark is our primary signature and the first thing people should recognise. Use it wherever there is room for the full name. Always use the supplied files from the library, never redraw, retype or edit it.
The logomark is the Tiugo T on an Orange 500 tile. Use it in small or square formats like app icons, avatars and favicons, always as one piece.
The logo should remain clear and readable on all approved backgrounds. On gradient backgrounds, place the logo in an area with sufficient contrast. If a background is not listed, use Neutrals 100.

The logo only works when it looks the same everywhere. Don’t stretch, rotate, outline, recolor or add effects to it, and don’t place it on patterns or low-contrast backgrounds. If the logo looks altered, go back to the original file.

Use neutral colors for primary backgrounds, surfaces, and typography. Orange 500 is the main accent, while blue and supporting colors add emphasis. Keep color combinations consistent across all brand materials.
Gradient backgrounds belong on covers, section openers and hero visuals. Crop them freely, but never put long text on them or build new gradients from palette colors.
Aspekta is our primary typeface, from headlines to body copy. Lab Mono is used only for eyebrows, labels, metadata, numbers and code. Keep one weight per line.

Large headlines are set in Aspekta 500, body copy in Aspekta 400 and labels in Lab Mono. Every size comes from the website text styles, from 72 px headlines to 14 px labels. Keep big contrast between steps and use few of them.
When Aspekta or Lab Mono aren't available, in Google Docs, Slides or email, use Geist and Geist Mono. They keep the same weights and roles, so layouts stay consistent.

Stepped blocks show content moving through the layer. Use the Hero pattern from the design system as a full-width band in heroes, covers and footers. Never redraw or recolor it, and keep logos and text off it.
The pattern works on Neutrals 900 as well as on Neutrals 100, with the same colors. Use it as a band at the edge of social posts, slides and banners, at full width and never behind text.
Floating UI cards show governance at work: attribution, approval and roles. They are built from real interface parts, set on a site gradient, with generous space around each card.
We use Lucide: open-source outline icons on a 24 px grid with a 2 px stroke and round caps. Use them at 24 px in Neutrals 900 or 600, always next to a label.

The Tiugo website uses clean layouts, warm neutral backgrounds, and generous whitespace. Consistent typography, clear navigation, and branded graphic elements create a cohesive experience across desktop and mobile.
A 6-column, 6-row grid with 120 px margins underpins every slide. The logo and page label sit on the top margin, headlines start on a row line, and images and cards span whole cells.
Social posts: lead with one statement or number, use gradients or the Hero pattern behind it, and keep the logo in Neutrals 900 or Neutrals 50. Square for feeds, vertical and landscape for LinkedIn.

name: CKEditor
tagline: The rich text editor for every use case

logos.label: Primary lockup
logos.note: Hexagon mark + CKEditor wordmark. The mark pairs CK Purple with CK Lime.

guidelines: CK Purple #7F00FD is the hero color; Deep Purple #310061 carries dark surfaces and backgrounds.
CK Lime is an accent — use it sparingly against purples for maximum contrast.
Use the tint scales (Lime, Deep Purple, Moon Gray) for illustration fills and layered surfaces rather than inventing new shades.

name: Tiny (TinyMCE)
tagline: The world's most trusted WYSIWYG editor

logos.label: Primary lockup
logos.note: Rounded mark + lowercase tiny wordmark, single color.

guidelines: Navy Blue #002FE6 is the action color; Dark Navy and Charcoal Navy carry dark surfaces.
Buttons and inputs use a 2px corner radius; cards and larger surfaces use 4px.
Fira Code renders all code samples — never set code in the body face.

name: ButterCMS
tagline: The headless CMS your marketing team will love

logos.label: Primary lockup
logos.note: Butter-pat mark on ButterYellow + serif wordmark in ButterBlue.

guidelines: Headers set in Neuton always sit in ButterBlue 050 on light surfaces; body copy in Open Sans.
ButterBlue 090 #010156 is the dark surface color with white text and ButterBlue 030 borders.
Standard border radius is 8px across cards, buttons, and imagery; page grid is 12 columns with 32px gaps, max layout 1440px.
